proposal.scope: Model-level ordering facts for the already-reviewed gpt-5.4-mini and gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17 lookup IDs; not provider/channel/deployment eligibility or billing. The dated snapshot retains its reviewed GPT-5.4 mini identity and base model tier.
proposal.summary: Add lightweight coding tiers and the first official announcement date, 2026-03-17, for gpt-5-4-mini and gpt-5-4-mini-2026-03-17 from the captured OpenAI announcement. Runtime routing fallback previously treated both IDs as unclassified and undated; it now orders them after unclassified models, within lightweight by newest release date first, then exact wire ID. For example, in a fallback pool containing only gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17 and gpt-5.5-pro, the order changes from the two mini IDs followed by gpt-5.5-pro to gpt-5.5-pro followed by the two mini IDs, in both balanced and robust modes. The first passing candidate may therefore change when fallback is used; actual selection depends on the pool and guards. The exact IDs were already reviewed in mapping.json; no new wire ID, snapshot release event, availability, protocol, tariff, effort set, or harness floor is inferred. Preserve all prior tier facts and citations, including Kimi K3's tier without an invented announcement date. Remaining report gaps and uncertain Copilot price/model bindings require an incomplete report and human review.
